title.en: The Passive, Advanced (is being built / has been done / must be done)
title.es: La voz pasiva avanzada (is being built / has been done / must be done)

text.en: The base of the passive is always be + participle, and be takes the tense or the modal verb. Continuous: is/was being + participle (“The bridge is being built.”). Perfect: has/have/had been + participle (“The report has been finished.”). With a modal: can/must/should be + participle (“This must be done today.”), and in the past should have been + participle. They match the Spanish “se está construyendo”, “se ha terminado” and “debe hacerse”.
text.es: La base de la pasiva es siempre be + participio, y be toma el tiempo o el verbo modal. Continuo: is/was being + participio («The bridge is being built.»). Perfecto: has/have/had been + participio («The report has been finished.»). Con modal: can/must/should be + participio («This must be done today.»), y en el pasado should have been + participio. Corresponden a los «se está construyendo», «se ha terminado» y «debe hacerse» del español.

rows: pasivo continuo en presente (se está construyendo)
pasivo continuo en pasado (se estaba construyendo)
pasivo perfecto en presente (se ha construido)
pasivo con modal en pasado (debería haberse hecho)

text.en: The action is happening now (is being), or was happening at a past moment (was being).
text.es: La acción ocurre ahora (is being), o ocurría en un momento pasado (was being).

examples.es: A new bridge is being built.

tr.en: A new bridge is being built.
tr.es: Se está construyendo un puente nuevo.

examples.es: The room was being cleaned when I arrived.

tr.en: The room was being cleaned when I arrived.
tr.es: Estaban limpiando el cuarto cuando llegué.

text.en: Has/have been shows a result for now, had been shows an event before a past point.
text.es: Has/have been muestra un resultado para ahora, had been muestra un hecho antes de un punto pasado.

tr.en: The report has been finished.
tr.es: El reporte ya se terminó.

examples.es: By the time we arrived, all the tickets had been sold.

tr.en: By the time we arrived, all the tickets had been sold.
tr.es: Para cuando llegamos, ya se habían vendido todos los boletos.

text.en: Modal + be + participle for the present and the future, modal + have been + participle for the past. After going to comes to be + participle.
text.es: Modal + be + participio para el presente y el futuro, modal + have been + participio para el pasado. Después de going to va to be + participio.

tr.en: This must be done today.
tr.es: Esto debe hacerse hoy.

examples.es: The documents should have been signed yesterday.

tr.en: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
tr.es: Los documentos debieron haberse firmado ayer.

text.en: Infinitive: to be + participle. -ing form: being + participle. After hope, want, expect comes to be; after enjoy, avoid, mind comes being.
text.es: Infinitivo: to be + participio. Forma -ing: being + participio. Después de hope, want, expect va to be; después de enjoy, avoid, mind va being.

examples.es: She hopes to be chosen for the team.

tr.en: She hopes to be chosen for the team.
tr.es: Ella espera ser elegida para el equipo.

examples.es: I enjoy being invited to parties.

tr.en: I enjoy being invited to parties.
tr.es: Me gusta que me inviten a las fiestas.

title.es: Verbos con dos objetos y pasivas de opinión

text.en: With give, send, show, tell the person can also be the subject: “I was given a gift.” A reporting form for general opinion: “He is said to be rich.”, “It is believed that…”
text.es: Con give, send, show, tell la persona también puede ser el sujeto: «I was given a gift.» Una forma de opinión general: «He is said to be rich.», «It is believed that…»

examples.es: I was given a gift by my boss.

tr.en: I was given a gift by my boss.
tr.es: Mi jefe me dio un regalo.

examples.es: The thieves are thought to have escaped by car.

tr.en: The thieves are thought to have escaped by car.
tr.es: Se cree que los ladrones escaparon en carro.

title.en: The get-passive and the perfect passive infinitive
title.es: La pasiva con get y el infinitivo pasivo perfecto

text.en: Get + participle is an informal passive, mostly for events: “She got fined.”, “He got promoted.” In a reporting passive about a past event comes to have been + participle: “The painting is believed to have been stolen.”
text.es: Get + participio es una pasiva informal, sobre todo para sucesos: «She got fined.», «He got promoted.» En una pasiva de opinión sobre un suceso pasado va to have been + participio: «The painting is believed to have been stolen.»

tr.en: She got fined for speeding.
tr.es: Le pusieron una multa por exceso de velocidad.

examples.es: The painting is believed to have been stolen.

tr.en: The painting is believed to have been stolen.
tr.es: Se cree que el cuadro fue robado.

text.en: You always mark the tense on the verb be, and the main verb stays a participle: not “is building”, but “is being built”. The Spanish “se” construction does not exist in English: se construye = is built.
text.es: El tiempo de la pasiva siempre se marca en el verbo be, y el verbo principal queda en participio: no «is building», sino «is being built». La construcción con «se» del español no existe en inglés: se construye = is built.

text.en: You name the agent (by + person) only when it is important or new information; otherwise leave it out: “The documents were signed.”
text.es: El agente (by + persona) se menciona solo cuando es importante o información nueva; si no, se omite: «The documents were signed.»

speak.en: The base of the passive is always «be» plus the participle, and «be» takes the tense or the modal verb. Continuous passive: «The bridge is being built». Perfect passive: «The report has been finished». With a modal: «This must be done today», and in the past «should have been done». With the infinitive: «to be chosen», with the -ing form: «being invited». A reporting form for general opinion: «He is said to be rich».
speak.es: La base de la pasiva es siempre «be» más participio, y «be» toma el tiempo o el verbo modal. Pasiva continua: «The bridge is being built». Pasiva perfecta: «The report has been finished». Con modal: «This must be done today», y en el pasado «should have been done». Con infinitivo: «to be chosen», con forma -ing: «being invited». Una forma de opinión general: «He is said to be rich».

items.sentence: The new bridge ___ built right now.

why.en: An action in progress (right now): is being + participle.
why.es: Una acción en marcha (right now): is being + participio.

has been.en: Has been built shows a finished result; right now marks a process in progress.
has been.es: Has been built muestra un resultado terminado; right now marca un proceso en marcha.

was being.en: Was being is past; right now refers to the present.
was being.es: Was being es pasado; right now se refiere al presente.

tr.en: The new bridge is being built right now.
tr.es: El nuevo puente se está construyendo en este momento.

items.sentence: When I arrived, the room ___ cleaned.

why.en: An action in progress at a past moment: was being + participle.
why.es: Una acción en marcha en un momento pasado: was being + participio.

is being.en: Is being is present; when I arrived points to the past.
is being.es: Is being es presente; when I arrived señala el pasado.

has been.en: Has been has a result for now; when I arrived marks a past point.
has been.es: Has been tiene un resultado para ahora; when I arrived marca un punto pasado.

tr.en: When I arrived, the room was being cleaned.
tr.es: Cuando llegué, estaban limpiando el cuarto.

items.sentence: She got ___ for speeding last week.

why.en: The get-passive: got + participle (informal, an event).
why.es: La pasiva con get: got + participio (informal, un suceso).

fine.en: “Got fine” is not a passive; you need the participle (fined).
fine.es: «Got fine» no es una pasiva; hace falta el participio (fined).

fining.en: “Got fining” would mean she fines someone; the get-passive needs the participle (fined).
fining.es: «Got fining» significaría que ella multa a alguien; la pasiva con get necesita el participio (fined).

tr.en: She got fined for speeding last week.
tr.es: La multaron por exceso de velocidad la semana pasada.

items.sentence: The painting is believed to ___ stolen last year.

why.en: A past event with the perfect passive infinitive: to have been + participle.
why.es: Un suceso pasado con el infinitivo pasivo perfecto: to have been + participio.

be.en: To be stolen refers to the present or the future; last year points to the past.
be.es: To be stolen se refiere al presente o al futuro; last year señala el pasado.

being.en: “To being” does not exist; you need to have been.
being.es: «To being» no existe; hace falta to have been.

examples: The thief is said to have been caught.
It is thought to have been lost.

tr.en: The painting is believed to have been stolen last year.
tr.es: Se cree que la pintura fue robada el año pasado.

why.en: A past modal passive: should have been + participle.
why.es: Una pasiva modal en pasado: should have been + participio.

be.en: Should be refers to the present or the future; yesterday points to the past.
be.es: Should be se refiere al presente o al futuro; yesterday señala el pasado.

being.en: After should comes the base verb, not an -ing form.
being.es: Después de should va el verbo base, no una forma -ing.

examples: The cake could have been saved.

tr.en: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
tr.es: Los documentos debieron haber sido firmados ayer.

items.sentence: The old house is going ___ down next year.

why.en: After going to comes to be + participle.
why.es: Después de going to va to be + participio.

to being pulled.en: After to comes the base verb (be), not being.
to being pulled.es: Después de to va el verbo base (be), no being.

to pulled.en: “To pulled” is incomplete; the passive also needs be: to be pulled.
to pulled.es: «To pulled» está incompleto; la pasiva también necesita be: to be pulled.

examples: The road is going to be closed.
The bridge is going to be built.

tr.en: The old house is going to be pulled down next year.
tr.es: La casa vieja va a ser demolida el próximo año.

why.en: After enjoy comes the -ing form: being + participle.
why.es: Después de enjoy va la forma -ing: being + participio.

to be.en: After enjoy there is no infinitive; you need the -ing form.
to be.es: Después de enjoy no va infinitivo; hace falta la forma -ing.

be.en: After enjoy the base verb does not stand; you need being.
be.es: Después de enjoy el verbo base no va; hace falta being.

examples: I do not mind being asked.

tr.en: I enjoy being invited to parties.
tr.es: Me gusta que me inviten a fiestas.

items.sentence: She hopes ___ chosen for the team.

why.en: After hope comes the to-infinitive: to be + participle.
why.es: Después de hope va el infinitivo con to: to be + participio.

being.en: After hope there is no -ing form; you need to be.
being.es: Después de hope no va forma -ing; hace falta to be.

be.en: After hope the verb be needs to before it.
be.es: Después de hope el verbo be necesita to delante.

tr.en: She hopes to be chosen for the team.
tr.es: Ella espera ser elegida para el equipo.

items.sentence: I ___ a gift by my boss last week.

why.en: The person is the subject, a past passive: was given.
why.es: La persona es el sujeto, una pasiva en pasado: was given.

gave.en: Gave is active; by my boss signals a passive construction.
gave.es: Gave es activo; by my boss indica una construcción pasiva.

was gave.en: “Was gave” does not exist; after was you need the participle (given).
was gave.es: «Was gave» no existe; después de was hace falta el participio (given).

tr.en: I was given a gift by my boss last week.
tr.es: Mi jefe me dio un regalo la semana pasada.

items.sentence: A gift ___ to me by my boss last week.

why.en: The thing is the subject, a past passive: was given to me.
why.es: La cosa es el sujeto, una pasiva en pasado: was given to me.

was gave.en: “Was gave” does not exist; you need the participle (given).
was gave.es: «Was gave» no existe; hace falta el participio (given).

gave.en: Gave is active; a gift cannot give someone, so you need the passive.
gave.es: Gave es activo; un regalo no puede dar a alguien, por eso hace falta la pasiva.

examples: The key was sent to her.
A book was shown to us.

tr.en: A gift was given to me by my boss last week.
tr.es: Un regalo me fue dado por mi jefe la semana pasada.

why.en: A general opinion: is said to be.
why.es: Una opinión general: is said to be.

says.en: “Says to be” is not correct; you need the reporting passive (is said to be).
says.es: «Says to be» no es correcto; hace falta la pasiva de opinión (is said to be).

said.en: “Said to be” alone is not a complete verb form; you need is said.
said.es: «Said to be» solo no es una forma verbal completa; hace falta is said.

examples: She is thought to be ill.
They are known to be late.

tr.en: He is said to be very rich.
tr.es: Se dice que él es muy rico.

items.sentence: The thieves ___ to have escaped by car.

why.en: A reporting passive about the past: are thought to have + participle.
why.es: Una pasiva de opinión sobre el pasado: are thought to have + participio.

think.en: “Think to have escaped” is not correct; the thieves do not think, people think about them.
think.es: «Think to have escaped» no es correcto; los ladrones no piensan, se piensa de ellos.

thinking.en: Thinking is not a full verb form; you need are thought.
thinking.es: Thinking no es una forma verbal completa; hace falta are thought.

examples: He is believed to have left.
She is said to have won.

tr.en: The thieves are thought to have escaped by car.
tr.es: Se cree que los ladrones escaparon en carro.

items.sentence: By the time we arrived, all the tickets ___ sold.

why.en: An event before a past point: had been + participle.
why.es: Un hecho antes de un punto pasado: had been + participio.

have been.en: Have been has a result for now; by the time we arrived points to the past.
have been.es: Have been tiene un resultado para ahora; by the time we arrived señala el pasado.

has been.en: Has been is singular and for now; tickets is plural and the sentence is past.
has been.es: Has been es singular y para ahora; tickets es plural y la oración es pasada.

tr.en: By the time we arrived, all the tickets had been sold.
tr.es: Para cuando llegamos, todos los boletos se habían vendido.

why.en: A past possibility in the passive: might have been + participle.
why.es: Una posibilidad pasada en pasiva: might have been + participio.

be.en: Might be refers to the present or the future; yesterday points to the past.
be.es: Might be se refiere al presente o al futuro; yesterday señala el pasado.

being.en: After might comes the base verb, not an -ing form.
being.es: Después de might va el verbo base, no una forma -ing.

examples: The letter might have been lost.

tr.en: The package might have been delivered yesterday.
tr.es: El paquete pudo haber sido entregado ayer.

items.sentence: The matter is ___ discussed by the committee at the moment.

why.en: A continuous passive: is being + participle.
why.es: Una pasiva continua: is being + participio.

been.en: “Is been” does not exist; you need has been or is being.
been.es: «Is been» no existe; hace falta has been o is being.

be.en: “Is be” does not exist; after is you need being for the continuous passive.
be.es: «Is be» no existe; después de is hace falta being para la pasiva continua.

tr.en: The matter is being discussed by the committee at the moment.
tr.es: El asunto está siendo discutido por el comité en este momento.

items.sentence: The window ___ broken by the time I got home.

why.en: A finished result before a past point: had been + participle.
why.es: Un resultado terminado antes de un punto pasado: had been + participio.

has been.en: Has been has a result for now; by the time I got home points to the past.
has been.es: Has been tiene un resultado para ahora; by the time I got home señala el pasado.

was being.en: Was being marks a process; by the time I got home asks for a result finished by then.
was being.es: Was being marca un proceso; by the time I got home pide un resultado terminado para entonces.

examples: The lights had been turned off.

tr.en: The window had been broken by the time I got home.
tr.es: La ventana ya estaba rota para cuando llegué a casa.

items.sentence: He got ___ at work last month.

why.es: La pasiva con get: got + participio (promoted).

promote.en: “Got promote” is not a passive; you need the participle (promoted).
promote.es: «Got promote» no es una pasiva; hace falta el participio (promoted).

promoting.en: “Got promoting” would mean he promotes someone; you need the participle (promoted).
promoting.es: «Got promoting» significaría que él asciende a alguien; hace falta el participio (promoted).

tr.en: He got promoted at work last month.
tr.es: Lo ascendieron en el trabajo el mes pasado.

text.es: pasiva continua: la acción ocurre ahora

tr.en: The report has been finished.
tr.es: El reporte ya se terminó.

text.en: continuous passive: still in progress
text.es: pasiva continua: aún en marcha

wrong.en: Has been finished marks a finished result; a process needs is being finished.
wrong.es: Has been finished marca un resultado terminado; un proceso necesita is being finished.

text.en: perfect passive: a result for now
text.es: pasiva perfecta: un resultado para ahora

text.en: past simple passive: a stated past time
text.es: pasiva en pasado simple: un tiempo pasado dado

wrong.en: Has been finished does not mark a stated past time but a result for now.
wrong.es: Has been finished no marca un tiempo pasado dado sino un resultado para ahora.

tr.en: This must be done today.
tr.es: Esto debe hacerse hoy.

text.en: a modal passive: must + be + participle
text.es: una pasiva modal: must + be + participio

text.en: continuous passive
text.es: pasiva continua

wrong.en: The continuous passive needs being; here be follows must directly.
wrong.es: La pasiva continua necesita being; aquí be va directamente después de must.

text.es: una pasiva en pasado

wrong.es: Una pasiva modal en pasado necesita must have been; must be done se refiere al presente o al futuro.

tr.es: Mi jefe me dio un regalo.

text.en: the gift is the subject
text.es: el regalo es el sujeto

wrong.en: In this sentence the person (I) is the subject; the gift is the object.
wrong.es: En esta oración la persona (I) es el sujeto; el gift es el objeto.

text.en: the person is the subject and the gift stays as object
text.es: la persona es el sujeto y el regalo queda como objeto

text.en: continuous passive
text.es: pasiva continua

items.es: He is said to be very rich.

tr.en: He is said to be very rich.
tr.es: Se dice que es muy rico.

text.en: he says that he is rich
text.es: él dice que es rico

wrong.es: Is said to be muestra lo que dicen otros; él no lo dice.

text.en: a future plan
text.es: un plan futuro

wrong.en: Is said to be shows a general opinion, not a plan.
wrong.es: Is said to be muestra una opinión general, no un plan.

text.es: una pasiva de opinión: una opinión general sin fuente
